_comment: Necromancer (Shadow) hero. Action - {r}, {t}: until end of turn you may play target zombie from your graveyard, go again. Plus: whenever a zombie you control dies, banish it face-down and create a Corrupted Corpse. The graveyard-zombie grant and the zombie-death trigger are stubbed; {r}=activation_cost, {t}=TAP_SELF, go again modeled.
